mapper.insert: insert into order_statistics (station_id, order_date, total_amount, total_num, create_time, update_time) select start_station_id, date(start_time), ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0), count(1), now(), now() from order_info where del_flag = '0' and start_station_id is not null and start_time >= concat(#{orderDateBegin}, ' 00:00:00') and start_time <= concat(#{orderDateEnd}, ' 23:59:59') group by start_station_id, date(start_time)
